designBrief: Minimalist, functional office-park coffee spot at Nordic European Centre, Singapore. Palette from the business's own real logo and real (non-AI) interior photography: warm off-white, warm brown, sage green, a single sparing dusty-rose accent. Archivo for headings, Public Sans for body — both plain, utilitarian faces matching a genuinely unpretentious real interior (glass display case, plain white chairs), not an artisanal look. Single-page, calm and easy to scan. Signature element: a thin circular ring accent echoing the round shape of the real logo badge, used once as a hero divider with a subtle 'coffee ring completing' draw-in, and small as inline menu-category markers. Note: this business's actual Instagram/Facebook are templated AI-styled promotional graphics, deliberately not imitated here.
